corporate.metaTitle: Corporate website development, end to end

Custom design in your visual identity, responsive on every device

steps.text: We settle the goals, the audience and the map of sections.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We draw the layouts around your brand and your users' journeys.

steps.title: Build and integrations
steps.text: We assemble the site and connect the CMS, forms, CRM and analytics.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: We publish, test, optimise and hand over the access.

faq.question: What does a corporate website cost?
faq.answer: It starts at {price:120000} and depends on the number of sections, the complexity of the design and the integrations. We give an exact figure after the brief.

faq.question: Will I be able to edit the content myself?
faq.answer: Yes. We connect a content system you can work in, so you can change text, news and sections without a developer.

faq.question: Will the site be optimised for search?
faq.answer: Yes. We lay in a correct structure, page speed, meta tags and structured data — the foundation for SEO.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: Usually from two weeks. The exact timeline depends on how many sections and integrations there are.

faq.question: What does a Telegram bot cost?
faq.answer: It starts at {price:50000} and depends on how complex the scenarios and integrations are. A Mini App with an interface and a client area starts at {price:100000}. We give an exact figure after the brief.

faq.question: How is a Mini App different from an ordinary bot?
faq.answer: A bot works through messages, buttons and commands. A Mini App is a full interface — effectively a small site — inside Telegram: screens, catalogue, forms, payment. The two are often combined.

faq.question: Can you connect payments and a CRM?
faq.answer: Yes. We connect payment providers, integrations with CRM and Google Sheets, notifications and external APIs, so enquiries and payments land straight in your processes.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: A simple bot goes live from one week, a Mini App from two. The final timeline depends on the scope and the integrations.
